items.title: Undo movement (Ctrl+Z & Undo move button) steps straight back without jumping to start
items.do: On Sylwen's turn in combat, drag 2 squares (A → B, spends 1 AP, 4 sq left), drag 2 more squares (B → C, 2 sq left), then press Ctrl+Z twice (or use the "Undo move" button in the Situational tab).
items.expect: First Ctrl+Z moves Sylwen directly from C to B (no jump back to A and no weird slide!), leaves 4 sq left with range redrawn, and drops Foundry's drag ruler by 2 sq; second Ctrl+Z moves Sylwen directly from B to A, refunds the 1 AP, closes the Advance banner, removes the movement from Turn Breakdown & Encounter Log, and resets Foundry's movement history to 0.
